message: Hey Sis, I was thinking it would be great to catch up with Michael from high school. Do you think you could help me reconnect with him?
Jane, can you send me the report on last year's alumni donations? Thanks!
Morning Jane! Are we still on for the meeting this Thursday?
Hi Jane, just a reminder about the alumni event next month. We need to finalize the guest list.
Remember when we used to hang out at the Springfield Diner after football games? Good times!
Absolutely, those were the days! I miss those milkshakes.
Sis, do you remember the name of that teacher who always had funny ties?
Mr. Thompson! He retired last year, but he's still rocking those ties at every reunion.
That's hilarious! We should definitely invite him to the next catch-up.
For sure, I'll add him to the list. It'll be nice to see him again.
